sources.location: https://ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2025/02/PXD057713/CTXB_data.zip (zip64 central directory read via HTTP range request; no data downloaded)

claims.evidence: The only RAW file is CTXB_data.zip; its directory lists 30 Data/*.raw folders, each claimed once.
PRIDE organism NEWT:1093790 Vibrio cholerae h1; sample is the CTXB protein. Recorded at species level.
Protocol: CTXB unbound vs CTXB-BL3.1 complex (1:5); run names CtxB_ vs CtxB-BL31_.
Protocol: HDX at 1, 10, 40, 100 min; ND01-06 are non-deuterated runs used for the peptide library.
Protocol: samples measured in triplicate; suffix to replicate mapping is inferred from file names.
Protocol: Synapt G2-Si, Waters; HDMSE acquisition m/z 50-2000.
HDMSE is an MSE-type alternating low/high energy DIA mode; choice is ours.
Protocol: peptide ID by tandem MS (CID); applied to all runs by assumption.

limitations: Raw data are inside a 44.8 GB zip; the archive was not downloaded, so .raw headers (_HEADER.TXT) were not checked.
Source rows, replicate suffixes and ND state are inferred from file names.
BL3.1 (deposit) vs BL3.2 (title/paper): paper not read.
No tolerances or modifications in deposit (PLGS output zips not opened).
